room.body: Muddy grass on a rocky rise, a granite boulder and autumn maples on it.

room.title: mushroom clearing
room.body: A clearing of muddy grass and gravel, a cluster of red mushrooms among granite boulders and bare maple stumps.

room.title: riftgate circle
room.body: A rubble floor ringing a glowing riftgate portal, hemmed by wooden support beams and a ruined plank wall.

room.title: weedy ruin patch
room.body: A small patch of sparse, rock-strewn grass among the prison's broken timber walls.

room.title: cluttered study
room.body: A wooden plank floor with a rustic table piled with books, a magnifying glass and a mortar, a stove and candles along the walls.

room.title: trapdoor shack
room.body: A brick rubble floor within ruined wooden walls, with broken chairs and a trapdoor set into the brick.
